Three identical bar magnets, each of mass $m$, and two identical trolleys, X and Y, also each of mass $m$, are arranged with the bar magnets fixed to the trolleys as shown. The trolleys are held at rest a short distance apart on a smooth horizontal track.
The trolleys are released at the same time. They move towards each other and collide.
Find the value of the ratio
$$\frac{\text{kinetic energy of X immediately before collision}}{\text{kinetic energy of Y immediately before collision}}$$
